products.name: Single Keystone Surface Mount Box
products.longDescription: Side-entry surface mount box for Cat 5 or Cat 6 keystone jacks and F-connectors. It has a snap-on cover for installation and wiring access, includes double-sided mounting tape, and is supplied unloaded in white.

products.name: Double Keystone Surface Mount Box
products.longDescription: Two-port side-entry surface mount box for Cat 5 or Cat 6 keystone jacks and F-connectors. It has a snap-on cover for installation and wiring access, includes double-sided mounting tape, and is supplied unloaded in white.

products.name: Yealink SIP-T54W Prime Business IP Phone
products.description: Yealink SIP-T54W Prime Business IP Phone
products.longDescription: Professional SIP desk phone with an adjustable 4.3-inch 480 x 272 colour display, support for up to 16 VoIP accounts, dual Gigabit Ethernet ports and Power over Ethernet. Integrated Bluetooth 4.2, dual-band Wi-Fi and a USB 2.0 port support flexible office deployments. The phone also includes Yealink Optima HD Voice with Opus codec support, a hearing-aid-compatible handset and wall-mount support.
